name: blogmaatic
description: Publication automation control plane, local runtime, operator API, and Control Room

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.runtime:init: npm run build --workspace @blogmaatic/runtime && node apps/runtime/dist/cli.js init
scripts.runtime:start: npm run build && node apps/runtime/dist/cli.js start
scripts.runtime:open: npm run build --workspace @blogmaatic/runtime && node apps/runtime/dist/cli.js open
scripts.runtime:stop: npm run build --workspace @blogmaatic/runtime && node apps/runtime/dist/cli.js stop
scripts.runtime:doctor: npm run build --workspace @blogmaatic/runtime && node apps/runtime/dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.runtime:token: npm run build --workspace @blogmaatic/runtime && node apps/runtime/dist/cli.js token
